steps.content: With the help of the mechanisms, K.K. eventually fights off the bunch of Corruptors and blocks the door. Julien still hasn't recovered from the shock.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: What about those two Sinners? The Corpus is not here. Why did you waste your time coming here?!
It's the first time you've seen him so impatient. Before offering much explanation, you glimpse the strange bomb in his hand and snatch it, tossing it to the distant corner.
Then you walk over and grab the microphone.
